name: W14 · Field-test capture (session end → sheet) + hourly nightly_stats → team summary

nodes.name: Session end (from API)
nodes.notes: Posted by the Go API (internal/study hooks.go OnSessionVerified, API env N8N_STUDY_WEBHOOK_PATH) after a server-verified session in cohort field_test. Signed envelope { ts, payload: '<JSON string>', sig }. payload = { event: 'session_end', event_id, cohort: 'field_test', participant_code: 'P-NNN', game, session_id, score, latency_ms, calibration: { n, brier, overconfidence }, server_checked, verified_at }. No names or contact details.

nodes.name: Verify envelope (HMAC)
nodes.notes: Needs the built-in `crypto` module in Code nodes (allowed on n8n Cloud; self-hosted: NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto).

nodes.name: Append to field-study sheet
nodes.notes: Team-only sheet (FIELD_STUDY §10), tab `sessions`. appendOrUpdate keyed on event_id, so a re-delivered event updates its row instead of adding a second one. A deletion request removes the rows too (backend → W14 sub-flow, later).

nodes.name: Every hour
nodes.notes: Hourly while the field test runs (FIELD_STUDY §5); deactivate the workflow after the data freeze. W13 keeps the nightly run.

nodes.name: API-67 start nightly_stats
nodes.notes: POST /internal/jobs/nightly_stats (API-67). The API starts the Render Workflows task nightly_stats (RW-4): study.export_csv → node field-kit/nazar_stats.mjs (unchanged, sha256 recorded) → stats.field_study_publish → API-71 cache. 202 → JobRun. No built-in retry: a retry must be re-signed.

nodes.name: nightly_stats: result
nodes.notes: ok = 2xx. retry = network error, 429 or 5xx, at most 3 attempts (re-signed). Anything else fails the run (→ W12).

nodes.name: nightly_stats: wait 10 s
nodes.notes: Back-off, then re-sign (same Idempotency-Key, fresh timestamp and signature).

parameters.errorMessage: =nightly_stats was not started: HTTP {{ $json.statusCode || 'network error' }} {{ ($json.body && $json.body.title) || $json.error?.message || '' }}. Runbook: docs/05-ops/RUNBOOK.md

nodes.name: GET /v1/stats/public
nodes.notes: API-71, public and unauthenticated (security: [{}]), so a plain retry is safe. Returns { as_of, nazar, journey_test, counters, disclaimer_key }.

margdarshak.business_logic: none (scores are server-verified in Go; statistics come from nazar_stats.mjs in the Render Workflows task nightly_stats; n8n copies whitelisted columns and formats)
margdarshak.executions_per_month: ≈ 400 session events + 24 per day while the field test runs
margdarshak.pii: pseudonymous participant code only; no names, contact details or free text; successful executions are not saved
margdarshak.signature_scheme: inbound: header auth + envelope sig = sha256=hex(HMAC(MD_HMAC_SECRET, ts + '.' + payload)); outbound: Bearer MD_N8N_READ_TOKEN + Margdarshak-Signature t=<unix>,v1=<hex hmac(t + '.' + body)> + Idempotency-Key
